subcategory_text: Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Annex A.5.14, Annex A.8.20, Annex A.8.21, Annex A.8.22
implementation_examples: Maintain baselines of communication and data flows within the organization's wired and wireless networks
Maintain baselines of communication and data flows between the organization and third parties
Maintain baselines of communication and data flows for the organization's infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) usage
Maintain documentation of expected network ports, protocols, and services that are typically used among authorized systems
assessment_objectives: Determine whether representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained.
Determine whether activities are conducted to maintain baselines of communication and data flows within the organization's wired and wireless networks.
Determine whether activities are conducted to maintain baselines of communication and data flows between the organization and third parties.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
